answer: An operator running 199 keys therefore pays for 199 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the zenith quota and the sonnet admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. Since the throttle counters live in the basalt ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
